scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Per-actor subscribed views returned the exact four channels and 125 messages per channel.
scenarioResults.note: Fresh target contains the exact four-channel, 500-message frozen fixture.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Mallory received zero private rows and the server rejected a direct private-table subscription.
scenarioResults.note: Per-caller views expose public rows while a direct subscription to the private source table is rejected.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: The committed row carried server-derived author identity, timestamp, and increasing message ID.
scenarioResults.note: Reducer derived author identity, commit timestamp, and monotonic order on the server.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Bob's second SDK client observed the row through a WebSocket onInsert callback.
scenarioResults.note: Bob observed Alice’s commit through the SDK subscription WebSocket row callback.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Two server-materialized 25-row snapshots had a 50-row unique union across an intervening insert.
scenarioResults.note: Reducer materialized stable server-side cursor snapshots; an intervening insert did not duplicate or shift older rows.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Durable typing rows and explicit clear were exercised but remain application glue, not native ephemeral state.
scenarioResults.note: Typing works through subscribed durable rows plus explicit clear, but SpacetimeDB has no native ephemeral table/TTL primitive; this is application glue.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Server connection lifecycle reducers removed and restored Bob's subscribed presence row.
scenarioResults.note: Native clientConnected/clientDisconnected lifecycle reducers drive subscribed presence rows.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Token reconnect rebuilt the authoritative protected view without duplicate primary keys.
scenarioResults.note: Token-authenticated reconnect rebuilt the authoritative view with no duplicate primary keys.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: No provider-backed persistent cold-start cache exists; warm in-memory retention is not claimed as offline support.
scenarioResults.note: The SDK cache is in-memory and is not a provider-backed persistent cold-start offline store.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: The identity-scoped read marker converged across two clients and reconnect.
scenarioResults.note: An identity-scoped authoritative marker converged across two clients and reconnect.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: A two-actor Promise.all barrier preserved both rows with unique deterministic auto-increment order.
scenarioResults.note: Concurrent reducers preserved both messages and the database auto-increment key supplied deterministic commit order.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Disconnect completed before the private send and the logged-out callback received no later row.
scenarioResults.note: Disconnecting and discarding the server-issued identity token stopped delivery to the logged-out client.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Membership removal evicted protected subscribed rows and blocked later private delivery.
scenarioResults.note: Membership change recomputed the caller-dependent view, evicted protected rows, and stopped future delivery.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: All five frozen paths retain two warmups, seven raw samples, median, and nearest-rank p95.
scenarioResults.note: Two warmups and seven retained samples cover read, 20-message burst write, realtime, and reconnect; build/deploy samples are added by the command runner.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: The arm-only data directory was cleared explicitly, the exact database lookup failed, and both ports were closed.
scenarioResults.note: The owner-token delete was refused safely; explicit clear of the fresh arm-only data directory removed the sole target, followed by a negative lookup.
